verdict.rationale: Factory does expose a Sessions API to create/manage Droid sessions (factory-docs-13, factory-docs-18), showing some API surface beyond the UI/CLI, but flagship UI/CLI features like Missions, readiness-report/readiness-fix, Skills, and Custom Droids are documented only as slash commands in the App/CLI, not as API endpoints, and no public OpenAPI/swagger spec could be found (factory-probe-2 shows 404s across candidate paths). Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for Missions, readiness reports, skills/custom droids, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
